items.title: Git-native offline bug tracking
items.oneliner: This embeds bug tracking in Git, works fully offline, and syncs through remotes without a hosted issue tracker.

items.title: On-demand Nix binaries filesystem
items.oneliner: This FUSE filesystem exposes nixpkgs binaries on demand, so you can run tools without installing them first.

items.title: Portable SIMD for Go
items.oneliner: This tutorial explains Go's new portable SIMD APIs for amd64, arm64, and wasm with near-assembly performance goals.

items.title: Agentic CUDA kernel optimizer
items.oneliner: This repo benchmarks generated CUDA kernels, keeps the fastest correct variant, and automates GPU tuning from workload descriptions.

items.title: Rust framework for server apps
items.oneliner: This Rust framework bundles views, ORM, and app structure to ship server applications faster without assembling the stack yourself.

items.title: Open-source IDE for agent collaboration
items.oneliner: This IDE gives humans and coding agents a shared canvas for architecture, edits, and review in one workspace.

items.title: F-Droid gets a major refresh
items.oneliner: This Android app store update improves discovery, search, and app management while keeping installs privacy-first and tracker-free.

items.title: FreeBSD desktop on EC2
items.oneliner: This walkthrough shows how to launch FreeBSD desktop AMIs on EC2 with RDP access and command-line setup steps.

items.title: Build an Org parser with PEG
items.oneliner: This tutorial shows how to parse Org files with PEG in Guile Scheme and export structured HTML via SXML.

items.title: Write Parquet files in Haskell
items.oneliner: This guide adds practical Parquet writing to Haskell dataframes, including APIs and file layout details for interoperability.
